In compliance with ADB's Safeguard Policy Statement (2009), the project is classified as category B for environment. The Environment Category was determined based on possible inclusion of Category B projects in the future, while the current portfolio has only category C projects. The environmental and social impacts of the potential projects have been identified and effective measures to avoid, minimize, mitigate, and compensate for the adverse impacts are incorporated in the Environment Social Management System. The institutional capacity and commitment of Engie to manage the project's social and environmental impacts are deemed adequate.
Information disclosure and consultations with affected people are conducted in accordance with ADB requirements.
